name: @gcu/scan
description: Kernels over a block model's records — grade-tonnage, swath, statistics, filters, values, positions — columnar and parallel, never resident. Parquet row groups, Datamine .dm page runs and indexed delimited runs (with zone-map skipping) on a pool of module workers, the same kernel on the page where workers can't run, partials merged in unit order so the answer never depends on which. Zero imports: its libraries (parquet, condenser, expr, sluice) are injected.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
